Legacy-era only (`2025-11-25` and earlier). Terminate the MCP session identified by the `Mcp-Session-Id` header. `2026-07-28` requests are sessionless and do not use DELETE. Subsequent legacy requests bearing the same session id will receive `404 Not Found`.
